I have investigated the failing test case [`BooleanUtilsTest.test_toBoolean_String`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_51_group_d_arch/src/test/org/apache/commons/lang/BooleanUtilsTest.java#L295-L335), deduced the intended behavior, and expressed it as a specification in [requirement.feature](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_51_group_d_arch/requirement.feature).

### Intended Behavior
When converting a string representation to a boolean value using [`BooleanUtils.toBoolean(String)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_51_group_d_arch/src/java/org/apache/commons/lang/BooleanUtils.java#L649-L700), input strings that do not represent `true` (such as `"tru"` or `"TRU"`) should evaluate to `false` rather than throwing an exception.

The specification has been written to [`requirement.feature`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_51_group_d_arch/requirement.feature).
